title: Cloak of Elemental Absorption

sources.title: Absorb Elements
markers: | description = Absorb elemental damage once per [[Short Rest]]. Take half damage from the next elemental attack targeting you, and deal an additional 1d6 of that element type on your next attack.

summary: Absorb Elements can halve incoming elemental damage and empower your next weapon attack.

fields.Absorb Elements: When hit by Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning or Thunder, spend a Reaction to gain resistance to that element against the triggering damage. The elemental effect lasts 2 turns and can add 1d6 of that element to your next weapon attack. Existing resistance does not stack.
fields.Recharge: Tooltip says Short Rest. The pinned item page reports a bug that makes the recharge Long Rest.
fields.Base value: 115 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay use and reviewed pinned source evidence. Expanded the card from the pinned item and linked gameplay evidence.
